about: Goderich is a town in Huron County, Ontario, on a bluff above Lake Huron at the Maitland River mouth. An octagonal town square, a working harbour and salt mine, and sunsets over the lake define this unique planned town. About 8,000 people live in Goderich.
seoSummary: Lake Huron bluff town at the Maitland mouth—octagonal square, harbour, and salt-mine port in Huron County.
knownFor: Planned town with a unique octagonal central square
